sr.title: Jesenja kaša sa karamelizovanim kruškama i pistaćima
sr.description: Jesen je stigla, a sa njom i sezona ušuškavanja, filmova i tople hrane koja miriše na cimet i bundevu. Ova kaša savršeno dočarava taj osećaj – svaki zalogaj kruške u slatko-kiselom sosu i cimetom bukvalno asocira na mirise i ukuse jeseni.
steps: Pomešaj ovsene pahuljice sa vodom i mlekom. Dodaj malo morske soli i kuvaj na tihoj vatri uz neprekidno mešanje.
Kada se kaša zgusne, dodaj aromu vanile, mericu proteina, kašiku kakaa i cimet. Dobro izmešaj.
Kruške iseckaj na tanke komade.
U tiganju otopi kockicu putera, kašiku meda i limunov sok, pa dobro izmešaj i dodaj kruške. Krčkaj na slaboj vatri 5–10 minuta.
U činiji preko ovsene kaše dodaj kruške i slatki sos.
Na kraju dodaj seckane pistaće za dodatnu hrskavost. Uživaj u ovom ukusnom jesenjem doručku! 🍂

en.title: Autumn Oatmeal with Caramelised Pears and Pistachios
en.description: Autumn is here, and with it the season of getting cosy, watching films and eating warm food that smells of cinnamon and pumpkin. This oatmeal captures that feeling perfectly – every bite of pear in its sweet-and-tangy cinnamon sauce tastes like autumn.
ingredients: 1 cup water and milk (I recommend half and half)
a few drops of vanilla extract
steps: Mix the oats with the water and milk. Add a pinch of sea salt and cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Once the oatmeal thickens, add the vanilla, protein powder, cocoa and cinnamon. Mix well.
Slice the pears thinly.
In a pan, melt the butter with the honey and lemon juice, stir well and add the pears. Simmer over low heat for 5–10 minutes.
Spoon the pears and their sweet sauce over the oatmeal in a bowl.
Finish with chopped pistachios for extra crunch. Enjoy this delicious autumn breakfast! 🍂

sr.title: Čoko-jagoda tortica 🍰
sr.description: Tortica od mlevenih badema sa čokoladnim filom od kokosovog mleka i svežim jagodama — bez belog šećera i brašna.
ingredients: kokosovo mleko iz konzerve (prethodno stajalo u frižideru)
tečni deo kokosovog mleka iz konzerve
steps: Najpre uključiti rernu na 180 stepeni.
Umutiti jaja i so, a zatim postepeno dodavati ostale sastojke, sem badema i praška za pecivo. Bademe dodati na kraju i umutiti ručno. Na kraju dodati prašak za pecivo.
Izliti u okrugli kalup od 26 cm sa odvojenim dnom, koji ste prethodno obložili pek papirom, i peći 30-ak minuta na 160 stepeni. Koru proverite čačkalicom — ako se smesa ne zalepi, gotovo je.
Izvucite koru iz kalupa i ostavite da se ohladi, pa je presecite na pola po širini kako biste dobili dve korice.
Čoko fil: ulje i čokoladu otopiti. U blenderu pomešati samo čvrsti deo kokosovog mleka i sve ostale sastojke, pa dobro izblendati.
Prvu koru poprskati mlekom, pa naređati seckane jagode preko nje, a zatim i 2/3 fila. Drugu koricu isto poprskati mlekom, ali sa unutrašnje strane, i premazati preostalim delom fila.
Ganaš: sve sastojke otopiti pa preliti preko tortice. Po želji ukrasiti voćem. Prijatno! ♥️

en.title: Sugar-Free Chocolate Strawberry Cake 🍰
en.description: A ground-almond cake with a coconut-milk chocolate filling and fresh strawberries — no refined sugar or flour.
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk (chilled in the fridge beforehand)
liquid part of the canned coconut milk
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Whisk the eggs with the salt, then gradually add the other ingredients except the almonds and baking powder. Fold in the almonds by hand at the end, then add the baking powder.
Pour into a 26 cm round springform pan lined with parchment paper and bake for about 30 minutes at 160°C. Test with a toothpick — if it comes out clean, it's done.
Remove the sponge from the pan and let it cool, then slice it in half horizontally to get two layers.
Chocolate filling: melt the oil and chocolate. In a blender, combine only the solid part of the coconut milk with all the other ingredients and blend well.

Sprinkle the first layer with milk, arrange the chopped strawberries over it and spread on 2/3 of the filling. Sprinkle the inside of the second layer with milk too, place it on top and cover with the remaining filling.
Ganache: melt all the ingredients together and pour over the cake. Decorate with fruit if you like. Enjoy! ♥️

sr.title: Čokoladna mus tortica od bundeve 🍫
sr.description: Kremasta čokoladna tortica od pečene bundeve i urmi. Preporuka je da napravite duplu smesu jer je zaista preukusno i nestane za tili čas! 😃
ingredients: 50 g proteina sa ukusom lešnika i čokolade (opciono)
ganaš od crne čokolade i kokosovog mleka
steps: Bundevu iseckajte na sitnije komade i pecite oko sat vremena na 200 stepeni (obavezno pleh pokriti alu folijom, kako bi bundeva ostala sočna).
Crnu čokoladu otopiti sa kašičicom kokosovog ulja.
Pomešati čokoladu i bundevu u blenderu zajedno sa urmama i proteinom. Protein možete slobodno izostaviti, dodala sam ga najviše zbog dodatnog ukusa čokolade i lešnika. 🤗
Izliti u posudu koju ste prethodno obložili pek papirom i ostaviti u frižideru najmanje 3h, a najbolje preko noći da se stegne.
Prebaciti torticu na tanjir i preliti ganašom od crne čokolade i kokosovog mleka. Ukrasiti seckanim bademima i jagodama, po želji. Prijatno! ♥️

en.title: Chocolate Pumpkin Mousse Cake 🍫
en.description: A creamy chocolate cake made from roasted pumpkin and dates. My tip: make a double batch, because it's so delicious it disappears in no time! 😃
ingredients: dark chocolate and coconut milk ganache
steps: Cut the pumpkin into small pieces and roast for about an hour at 200°C (be sure to cover the tray with foil so the pumpkin stays moist).
Melt the dark chocolate with a teaspoon of coconut oil.
Blend the chocolate and pumpkin together with the dates and protein powder. You can leave out the protein — I added it mostly for the extra chocolate-hazelnut flavour. 🤗
Pour into a dish lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, ideally overnight, to set.
Turn the cake out onto a plate and pour over a dark chocolate and coconut milk ganache. Decorate with chopped almonds and strawberries if you like. Enjoy! ♥️

sr.title: Četvorostruki užitak 🌸
sr.description: Red blanširanih badema, red čoko musa, red džema od malina i sve to preliveno kremastim ganašom. Bez belog šećera, mleka i belog brašna — pogodno za vegane i ljude koji poste. 😊
steps: Kora: sve sastojke izblendati i formirati koricu u kalupu koji je obložen pek papirom.
Čoko mus: najpre otopiti čokoladu i kokosovo ulje, pa sjediniti u blenderu sa ostalim sastojcima. Preliti preko korice.
Džem od malina: sve sastojke pomešati i kuvati na tihoj vatri 7–8 minuta. Prohlađen džem preliti preko čoko musa.
Ganaš: sve sastojke otopiti i preliti kolač.
Ostaviti kolač oko 3h da se stegne i uživati u ukusima bez griže savesti! Prijatno! 💕

en.title: Fourfold Delight: Vegan Almond, Chocolate & Raspberry Cake 🌸
en.description: A layer of blanched almonds, a layer of chocolate mousse, a layer of raspberry jam, all covered in a creamy ganache. No refined sugar, dairy or white flour — suitable for vegans and anyone fasting. 😊
steps: Crust: blend all the ingredients and press into a pan lined with parchment paper.
Chocolate mousse: first melt the chocolate and coconut oil, then blend with the remaining ingredients. Pour over the crust.
Raspberry jam: mix all the ingredients and simmer over low heat for 7–8 minutes. Pour the cooled jam over the chocolate mousse.
Ganache: melt all the ingredients and pour over the cake.
Let the cake set for about 3 hours and enjoy the flavours guilt-free! Enjoy! 💕

sr.title: Proteinski vanila-jagoda tart bez šećera 🍓
sr.description: Tart je zdrav, bez šećera, belog brašna i mlečnih proizvoda, pa je pogodan i za vegane i za ljude koji poste. Spoj džema od jagoda i kremastog fila od vanile čine ga idealnim prolećnim slatkišem, a namirnica koja ga čini tako kremastim i punim proteina je svileni tofu (silken tofu).
ingredients: par kašika vode u kojoj su bile potopljene urme
100 g indijskog oraha (potopljenog 2–3h u toploj vodi)
nar ili omiljeno voće za ukrašavanje
steps: Sve sastojke za koricu samleti u blenderu i utisnuti u kalup za tart, debljine oko 1/2 cm.
Koricu premazati džemom od jagoda bez šećera.
Vanila krem: najpre sameljite indijske orahe i mleko, a onda dodajte sve ostale sastojke i blendajte dok ne dobijete ujednačenu masu.
Preliti fil preko tarta i po želji dodati nar ili neko omiljeno voće preko.
Dobro ohladiti u zamrzivaču i uživati! Prijatno! ♥️

en.title: Sugar-Free Protein Vanilla Strawberry Tart 🍓
en.description: This tart is healthy, with no sugar, white flour or dairy, so it's suitable for vegans and anyone fasting. Strawberry jam and a creamy vanilla filling make it the perfect spring treat, and the secret to its creaminess and protein is silken tofu.
ingredients: 7–8 dates (soaked in warm water for 5–10 minutes)
a few tbsp of the date soaking water
100 g cashews (soaked in warm water for 2–3 hours)
pomegranate or your favourite fruit to decorate
steps: Blend all the crust ingredients and press into a tart pan, about 1/2 cm thick.
Spread the crust with sugar-free strawberry jam.
Vanilla cream: first blend the cashews with the milk, then add all the remaining ingredients and blend until smooth.
Pour the filling over the tart and top with pomegranate or your favourite fruit if you like.
Chill well in the freezer and enjoy! ♥️

sr.title: Zdrava snikers tortica 🎂
sr.description: Ukoliko želite da obradujete nekoga dezertom koji ćete jesti u slast, bez osećaja krivice, ovo je pravi recept za vas. Jako se jednostavno i brzo pravi, sem što je indijske orahe potrebno potopiti u vodi nekoliko sati pre pripreme.
ingredients: pola konzerve punomasnog kokosovog mleka (samo čvrsti deo)
3 kašike kikiriki putera u prahu (ili kikiriki puter)
steps: Urme potopiti u toploj vodi 10-ak minuta, pa samleti tako da dobijete pastu. Pomešati sve sastojke za koru i razvući koricu debljine oko 1/2 cm. Ostaviti koricu u frižider dok pripremate fil.

Kikiriki fil: najpre u blenderu samleti indijski orah i mleko tako da dobijete teksturu krem sira, a onda dodati i ostale sastojke i blendati dok ne dobijete kremastu, ujednačenu masu. Preliti preko korice pa odložiti ponovo u frižider.
Čokoladni fil: isti postupak kao i sa prethodnim filom.
Ganaš: na pari otopiti sve sastojke i mešati dok ne dobijete ujednačen, kremast ganaš. Preliti preko torte.
Tortu ostaviti u frižideru da se stegne najmanje 3h, a najbolje preko noći. Garantujem da se nećete pokajati! Prijatno 🥰

en.title: Healthy Snickers Cake 🎂
en.description: If you want to treat someone to a dessert they can enjoy without any guilt, this is the recipe for you. It's quick and easy to make — you just need to soak the cashews in water for a few hours beforehand.
ingredients: half a can full-fat coconut milk (solid part only)
3 tbsp powdered peanut butter (or regular peanut butter)
remaining solid part of the coconut milk
liquid part of the coconut milk
steps: Soak the dates in warm water for about 10 minutes, then blend into a paste. Mix all the crust ingredients and press out a crust about 1/2 cm thick. Keep it in the fridge while you make the filling.

Peanut filling: first blend the cashews and milk until they have a cream-cheese texture, then add the remaining ingredients and blend until creamy and smooth. Pour over the crust and return to the fridge.
Chocolate filling: same method as the previous filling.
Ganache: melt all the ingredients over a water bath, stirring until you get a smooth, creamy ganache. Pour over the cake.
Leave the cake in the fridge to set for at least 3 hours, ideally overnight. I promise you won't regret it! Enjoy 🥰

sr.title: Osvežavajuća limun pasta 🍋
sr.description: Kremasta pasta sa limunom, belim lukom, parmezanom i svežim začinskim biljem.
ingredients: 300 g paste (ja sam koristila integralne fusile)
puna kašika nutritivnog kvasca (opciono — umesto njega malo buđavog sira ili još kašika parmezana)
steps: Skuvati testeninu po uputstvu i ostaviti jednu šoljicu vode u kojoj se kuvala pasta, za sos.
Na kockici putera propržiti sitno seckani beli luk. Zatim postepeno dodavati neutralnu pavlaku i vodu u kojoj se kuvala pasta, uz povremeno mešanje.
Na kraju umešati parmezan, nutritivni kvasac i limunov sok. Začiniti po želji.
Bademe sitno iseckati, pa posuti preko servirane paste, a opciono dodati i malo čilija. Prijatno! ♥️

en.title: Refreshing Lemon Pasta 🍋
en.description: Creamy pasta with lemon, garlic, parmesan and fresh herbs.
ingredients: 1 heaped tbsp nutritional yeast (optional — swap for a little blue cheese or another spoon of parmesan)
a few roasted almonds for sprinkling
steps: Cook the pasta according to the package, reserving one cup of the cooking water for the sauce.
Sauté the finely chopped garlic in the butter. Then gradually add the cream and the pasta water, stirring occasionally.
Finally, stir in the parmesan, nutritional yeast and lemon juice. Season to taste.
Finely chop the almonds and sprinkle over the served pasta, adding a little chilli if you like. Enjoy! ♥️

sr.title: No guilt palačinke 🥞
sr.description: Palačinke od banane, jaja i ovsenih pahuljica, sa idejama za fil. Lično meni je kombinacija badem-med savršena, a vi isprobajte i javljajte utiske.
ingredients: 200 ml proteinskog šejka (ja sam koristila ukus jagode)
steps: U posudi izgnječiti banane, pa dodati jaja i umutiti, a zatim dodati i ostale sastojke, sem pahuljica.
Kada ste sve lepo umutili, na kraju dodajte i pahuljice. Sačekajte 5–10 minuta da se sastojci povežu.
Pecite palačinke na zagrejanom tiganju na par kapi kokosovog ulja.
Ređajte palačinke naizmenično sa topinzima, koliko god u visinu želite. 😃 Prijatno! ♥️

en.title: No-Guilt Banana Oat Pancakes 🥞
en.description: Pancakes made with banana, eggs and oats, plus topping ideas. Personally, I think the almond-honey combo is perfect — give it a try and let me know what you think.
ingredients: 200 ml protein shake (I used strawberry flavour)
steps: Mash the bananas in a bowl, add the eggs and whisk, then add the remaining ingredients except the oats.
Once everything is well mixed, add the oats last. Let the batter rest for 5–10 minutes so it comes together.
Cook the pancakes in a hot pan with a few drops of coconut oil.
Stack the pancakes, alternating with the toppings, as high as you like. 😃 Enjoy! ♥️

sr.title: Kajgana sa avokado namazom na hrskavom hlebu 🥑🍳
sr.description: Verujem da ovde ni ne moram da pišem recept, ali ću ipak ostaviti način na koji ga ja pripremam, ukoliko neko želi da isproba. 🙂
steps: Jaja dobro ulupajte, pa dodajte malo mleka i so i pržite kajganu u tiganju u kojem ste prethodno otopili kockicu putera.
Avokado izgnječite, dodajte limunov sok, malo soli, bibera i čilija i sve izmešajte.
Hleb namažite malo puterom pa zagrejte na ugrejanom tiganju (2–3 minuta po strani).
Složite sendvič: namažite avokado namaz na hleb, dodajte kajganu i opciono malo ceri paradajza i rendani parmezan. Prijatno!

en.title: Scrambled Eggs with Avocado on Crispy Toast 🥑🍳
en.description: I'm sure I don't even need to write out a recipe for this, but I'll share how I make it in case anyone wants to try. 🙂
steps: Beat the eggs well, add a little milk and salt, and scramble them in a pan in which you've melted a knob of butter.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, a little salt, pepper and chilli.
Butter the bread lightly and toast it in a hot pan (2–3 minutes per side).
Assemble: spread the avocado on the toast, add the scrambled eggs and, optionally, some cherry tomatoes and grated parmesan. Enjoy!

sr.title: Limun pita sa meringom 🍋🥧
sr.description: Prhko testo, kremasti fil od limuna i pečeni meringue. P.S. Limun uvek najpre ostavim u vodi sa sodom bikarbonom i kašikom alkoholnog sirćeta, zbog uklanjanja pesticida sa korice.
steps: U veću činiju ubacite brašno, so, šećer u prahu i na kockice narezan puter. Prstima sve trljajte tako da dobijete mrvičastu smesu. Zatim dodajte jaje i zamesite glatko testo.
Testo razvijte na lagano pobrašnjenoj površini, pa prekrijte njime dno kalupa za tart koji ste prethodno obložili pek papirom.
Kalup s testom ostavite u zamrzivač na 15 minuta. Rashlađeno testo izbodite viljuškom i pecite 8 minuta u rerni zagrejanoj na 180°C.
Za to vreme pripremite fil: limunovu koricu i sok, vodu, šećer i gustin dobro izmiksajte, a zatim kuvajte na laganoj vatri dok se ne počne zgušnjavati.

U zasebnoj činiji izmutite žumanca, dodajte nekoliko kašika kuvanog fila i dobro izmiksajte. Vratite sve u šerpu i kuvajte još minut da se malo zgusne. Sklonite s vatre, dodajte puter i mešajte dok se ne otopi.
Fil od limuna izlijte preko polupečenog testa i lepo poravnajte.
Meringue: belancima dodajte prstohvat soli i miksajte dok se ne pretvore u mekani sneg. Postepeno dodajte šećer i miksajte dok se sav šećer ne otopi. Na kraju dodajte gustin i još kratko izmiksajte.
Pitu prekrijte meringom. Krenite od ruba, tako da belanca dodiruju testo, pa popunite i sredinu.
Pecite 20–25 minuta na 160°C, dok ne poprimi lagano smeđu boju.
Pre posluživanja pitu dobro ohladiti u frižideru. Uživajte!

en.title: Lemon Meringue Pie 🍋🥧
en.description: Shortcrust pastry, a creamy lemon filling and baked meringue. P.S. I always soak the lemons first in water with baking soda and a spoonful of white vinegar to remove pesticides from the peel.
steps: Put the flour, salt, powdered sugar and diced butter in a large bowl. Rub everything together with your fingertips until crumbly. Then add the egg and knead into a smooth dough.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface and use it to line a tart pan lined with parchment paper.
Put the pan in the freezer for 15 minutes. Prick the chilled dough with a fork and bake for 8 minutes in an oven preheated to 180°C.
Meanwhile, make the filling: whisk the lemon zest and juice, water, sugar and cornstarch, then cook over low heat until it starts to thicken.

In a separate bowl, beat the egg yolks, add a few spoonfuls of the hot filling and mix well. Return everything to the pot and cook for another minute until slightly thicker. Remove from the heat, add the butter and stir until melted.
Pour the lemon filling over the part-baked crust and smooth it out.
Meringue: add a pinch of salt to the egg whites and beat until soft peaks form. Gradually add the sugar, beating until it has completely dissolved. Finally, add the cornstarch and beat briefly.
Cover the pie with the meringue. Start at the edge so the meringue touches the pastry, then fill in the middle.
Bake for 20–25 minutes at 160°C, until lightly golden.
Chill the pie well in the fridge before serving. Enjoy!

sr.title: Noisette tart 🍫
sr.description: Mlečna čokolada, hrskavi pečeni lešnici i mleveni keks u savršenom skladu — samo 20 minuta pripreme! Napomena: ovaj recept ne pripada kategoriji zdravih recepata, ali ipak ga ostavljam jer je baš privukao pažnju! 😀♥️
steps: Puter istopiti na srednjoj vatri, pa preliti preko miksa mlevenih lešnika, keksa, kakaa i šećera. Sjedinite lepo, pa dospite mleko.
Izmešajte smesu tako da dobijete testastu teksturu, pa je utisnite na dno i ivice kalupa (obloženog papirom za pečenje ako kalup nema odvojivo dno).
Za fil u šerpici izlomite čokoladu, naseckajte puter na kockice i prelijte slatkom pavlakom, pa otopite na laganoj vatri uz neprestano mešanje.
Preko podloge u krug poređajte lešnike, pa prelijte filom.
Ostaviti par sati u frižideru, a ako se strpite i ostavite preko noći, biće idealno 🥰

en.title: Noisette Chocolate Hazelnut Tart 🍫
en.description: Milk chocolate, crunchy roasted hazelnuts and crushed biscuits in perfect harmony — just 20 minutes of prep! Note: this one isn't from my healthy recipes, but I'm keeping it because it got so much attention! 😀♥️
steps: Melt the butter over medium heat and pour it over the mixed ground hazelnuts, biscuits, cocoa and sugar. Combine well, then add the milk.
Mix until it has a dough-like texture, then press it over the bottom and up the sides of the pan (lined with parchment paper if it doesn't have a removable base).
For the filling, break the chocolate into a small saucepan, add the diced butter and the cream, and melt over low heat, stirring constantly.
Arrange the hazelnuts in a circle over the base, then pour over the filling.
Refrigerate for a few hours — and if you can wait until the next day, it's ideal 🥰
